title: You may remember the mistakes.
paragraphs:
You may remember the mistakes.
The shame.
The moments you wish you could erase.
But heaven tells a different story.

Through Jesus, you are forgiven.
Through Jesus, you are redeemed.

Your past may explain you,
but it no longer defines you.
Your story didn’t end in sin.
📖 “In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of sins.” — Ephesians 1:7
